author: sjm41
body:
* **ARBA rule (ID and label):**
ARBA00028131

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Dmel CG31266 (B7Z0L3)
Dmel CG31267 (Q8INA0)
Dmel kappaTry (A1Z8J7)

* **Description of issue**
ARBA00028131 adds 'endopeptidase activity' (GO:0004175) to these 3 Dmel proteins, but there are all pseudo-peptidases and manually annotated with 'NOT serine-type endopeptidase activity'.

I can't easily see that this is based on InterPro signatures, so assume it is based on a PANTHER or FunFam rule, but I can't tell which.
title: ARBA2GO issue: ARBA00028131

author: Antonialock
body:
it's [2.40.10.10:FF:000047](https://www.cathdb.info/version/latest/funfam/2.40.10.10:FF:000047)

in addition to the go term endopeptidase activity,
A1Z8J7 also gets EC, recname,  Serine protease kw, the other two gets kws

no papers, but at least the GO term should be block-able with with a blacklist from NOTs
